backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, admin roles, and authorization with hardcoded initial admin and access-controlled profile operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing files, components, and test IDs related to rebuilding the admin-granting feature.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend files, mainly React components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and applying base UI styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title and loads the main React application script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling navigation, authentication, role-based access, profile setup, and conditional fetching of admin-only resources.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: UI component displaying an access-denied message with a button to navigate back to the profile page.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Empty placeholder file intended for authentication-related UI controls.
frontend/src/components/CO2Chart.tsx: Recharts component rendering CO₂ data with labeled series, formatted timestamps, brush-based zooming, and synchronized range updates.
frontend/src/components/CoolingHeatingVe: Renders a Recharts line chart visualizing cooling, heating, and ventilation percentages with brush-based range selection.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCard.ts: Provides a styled card wrapper with a header, optional action, and content area for dashboard widgets.
frontend/src/components/FanVoltageFlowCo: Displays fan voltage and pressure data on dual Y-axes using Recharts with time labeling and range brushing.
frontend/src/components/LogSystemTitleBa: Implements a title bar with navigation, theme toggle, refresh, profile menu, and optional admin download button.
frontend/src/components/ProfileMenu.tsx: Shows a dropdown menu for user info, principal copying, account navigation, and sign-out actions.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal prompting first‑time users to enter and save their profile name.
frontend/src/components/TemperatureChart: Renders temperature and setpoint data using Recharts with detailed tooltips, legend, and range brushing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminList.ts: Fetches the list of admins via actor.getAllAdmins with error handling and conditional enabling.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Loads the current user's profile from the actor and exposes tailored loading and error state.
Computes a global last-updated timestamp by watching the temperature-series query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoogleSheetsDownlo: Retrieves and caches a Google Sheets download URL from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogSystemNavigatio: Manages navigation through log system pages with index tracking and navigation helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains mutations for saving user profiles and granting admin rights, with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncedTimeWindow.t: Manages a zoomable time window over data arrays and computes the visible range.
Fetches and caches temperature-series data with manual refresh and tracks last updated time.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeSession.ts: Tracks dark/light theme in session storage and syncs it to the document class.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light/dark themes and chart colors.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureDataSource.t: Fetches raw temperature data from a Google Apps Script endpoint and parses it into structured points.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureParsing.ts: Parses raw temperature/CO2 data, including numeric normalization and timestamp interpretation.
frontend/src/logSystems/logSystemPages.t: Lists available log system pages with metadata and their associated components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and Internet Identity providers and mounts App.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page using Internet Identity with a button that triggers login and handles already-authenticated errors.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page allowing users to edit their name and for admins to grant admin rights, view admin list, and copy principal IDs.
frontend/src/pages/TemperatureDashboardP: Dashboard showing temperature-related charts with date-range filtering, zoom controls, and data loading states.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLogger1Page.tsx: Placeholder page rendering an empty centered container.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining themes, colors, typography, animations, and utility extensions.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing admin-system requirements, existing issues, and feature requests.
